subject: Order Form: pricing splay, prorated tiers & tax residency evidence
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form questions: pricing tiers, prorating, and VAT evidence

Marcus —

Thanks for the draft order form. A few items procurement needs clarified before we can route to finance:

- Pricing splay: the schedule in Annex A lists annual tiers but our commitment will be phased across Q4/Q1. Will Redwood prorate the unit price for a partial first-year commitment, or do you invoice a full-year tranche up front?
- Minimum commits: can we agree to a 6-month initial minimum instead of a full-year for the first tranche? If not, please confirm early-termination credit mechanics.
- Net terms & invoice cadence: our standard is Net 60 with PO-attached invoices. Your order form shows Net 45. Can we confirm Net 60 for Acadia? Also confirm if Redwood will include PO number on the invoice header.
- Taxes / VAT: Acadia has EU subsidiaries that may require reverse-charge handling. What evidence do you require for VAT exemption (tax residency certificate, VAT number, signed declaration)?

We have a PO template and can share tax residency certs once we have a definitive list of required documents. Can you and your legal team confirm? If needed, we can schedule a quick call tomorrow.

Attachments: Acadia_PO_template.pdf (we'll send if helpful)

Thanks,
Jenna Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acadia Health
jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com
+44 20 5555 0100
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions: pricing tiers, prorating, and VAT evidence

Jenna —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below; Laura and Kim, I copied you for legal/tax language and invoice ops.

- Proration: Redwood can prorate the first tranche for the portion of the year consumed and invoice only for the prorated amount on the initial invoice. Annex A will show the pro-rata calculation (monthly basis) and we'll produce a line-item showing the calculation.
- Minimum commits: we can accept a 6-month initial minimum for Q4, followed by annual commit thereafter. We will add an early-termination credit: unused committed units converted to a 90-day credit that can be applied to future invoices (details to be redlined).
- Net terms / PO on invoice: We can accept Net 60 for Acadia for this order form. We will also include the PO number in the invoice header. Note: our standard billing system issues monthly invoices; if you prefer consolidated quarterly invoices let us know and we'll scope it.
- VAT evidence: Redwood requires either (1) a VAT number with matching company registration or (2) a signed tax residency declaration plus a company registration extract for reverse-charge. Kim / Laura — please confirm the exact doc list and whether Redwood will accept a signed electronic certificate.

I've attached our suggested redline for the Order Form (Acadia_OrderForm_redline_v1.docx) with the above changes called out. Happy to jump on a 30-min call Monday to finalize.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0199
Attachment: Acadia_OrderForm_redline_v1.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions: pricing tiers, prorating, and VAT evidence

Hi Jenna / Marcus —

Thanks — I reviewed Marcus's redline and added legal comments focused on the commercial mechanics and tax language. High-level items I redlined:

1) Minimum commitment clause: accepted 6-month initial minimum but added a clarity paragraph that the annual commit restarts on the next anniversary and that any shortfall in subsequent annual periods will be invoiced pro rata per Section 3.2.

2) Early-termination credit: clarified formula so credit equals (unused committed units * unit price) * (remaining days in commitment / 365), capped at amount invoiced. This ensures symmetrical treatment across currencies; included example in footnote.

3) Invoicing and PO: we will include the customer's PO number on all invoice headers and add a short payment instruction block referencing the PO. Please confirm whether Acadia needs consolidated quarterly invoices or monthly.

4) Taxes / VAT clause: recommend the following approach for EU reverse-charge scenarios:
   - Redwood will not collect VAT where valid reverse-charge evidence is provided prior to first invoice.
   - Acceptable evidence: EU VAT number (VIES validation screenshot), recent company extract (<= 90 days), and a signed tax residency declaration (template attached: RDW_tax-evidence-template.pdf).
   - If evidence is not provided within 30 days of order activation, Redwood will invoice gross VAT and will issue a credit on receipt of valid evidence for the invoiced VAT amount.

5) Currency & tax handling examples: added two worked examples for EUR invoicing with reverse-charge vs. VAT charged and later credited.

Attachments: I attached my redline (Acadia_OrderForm_redline_v2.docx) and the tax evidence template (RDW_tax-evidence-template.pdf). Marcus — please include the redline in the DocuSign envelope and update Annex A with the prorate math.

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form questions: pricing tiers, prorating, and VAT evidence

Marcus / Laura / Kim —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the two redlines. We've reviewed internally with finance and can confirm the following:

- Net terms: Acadia will accept Net 60. Please add PO number on all invoices; our AP team will send PO series for the Q4 tranche by end of day Monday.
- Proration & billing cadence: we accept monthly prorated initial invoice per your Annex A calculation. Finance prefers monthly invoices over consolidated quarterly for reporting reasons.
- Minimum commit: 6-month initial minimum accepted; we agree with the early-termination credit language as redlined.
- VAT / reverse charge: we can provide the EU VAT numbers and company extracts for the subsidiaries covered by this order. We will use your RDW_tax-evidence-template.pdf for the signed declarations. We expect to deliver the documents within 7 business days from order activation.

Please proceed to produce the final order form with Laura's redlines and send the DocuSign link. Also confirm whether Redwood needs any additional onboarding paperwork to enable reverse-charge processing at first invoice.

Looking forward —
Jenna Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acadia Health
jenna.ortiz@acadia-health.com
+44 20 5555 0100
